title: Failure scenario
description: Text over its maxLength is kept up to half as long again and dropped past that. One stored row of .reliability/audit/scenarios/<FLOW-id>.jsonl: a short story on a recorded flow's steps that shows where it breaks. The scenario author writes the fields without a 'stamped' note; audit record-step validates them against the flow and the working tree and stamps the rest. The verifier's outcome moves status and adds verifiedBy.

flowFingerprint.description: Stamped: the flow's fingerprint.core the scenario was written against; a scenario whose flow changed since is shown as written against an earlier trace.

at.description: The flow step before or during which the trigger hits.

stepRef.description: A step id of the flow; null only for the INJECTED trigger step.

brokenAt.description: The arrow drawn broken: the stepRef of a BROKEN, LOST, DUPLICATE or HUNG story step. May be null when outcome.kind is NONE.

kind.description: NONE: the author checked the pattern and found it harmless here.

businessPart.description: A business part id of the flow; required unless kind is NONE.

name.description: When present and the scenario explains a place, one of that rule's mitigation names.

ruleId.description: The code hint's rule of the place the scenario explains; stamped from placeId.

placeId.description: A place the flow crosses. A draft may give only ruleId when one place on the flow has that rule.

mitigationsChecked.description: Required with a place: every mitigation name of its rule, with FOUND, PARTIAL, NOT_FOUND or NOT_CHECKED.

scope.description: Computed: STEP when one STEP change alone closes every broken story step, CONCEPT otherwise. Absent on a harmless scenario.

proposedScope.description: What the author wrote, when it wrote one.

closes.description: At least one entry unless the scenario is harmless.

steps.description: The story's stepRefs this change closes.

snippet.description: Must occur within two lines of line.

finding.description: Required unless the scenario is harmless: what the derived finding recommends.

status.description: Stamped: CANDIDATE, or HARMLESS when outcome.kind is NONE; the verifier's outcome moves it to VERIFIED or DISPROVED, and a DOUBT leaves it CANDIDATE with confidence one step lower.

findingId.description: Stamped: the finding derived from this scenario.

verifiedBy.description: Stamped from the verifier's draft: model, run, outcome (VERIFIED, DISPROVED, DOUBT or BLOCKED), note, evidence, filesOpened, verifiedAt.

blockedBy.description: Stamped when the verifier found the mechanism real but another defect stops the flow earlier: what and evidence. The scenario counts as verified and bites once that defect is fixed.
